PROSE:
The heavy blast doors hissed open into the polished stone of the Audit Corridor, immediately triggering a barrage of automated 'cease and desist' bolts. 

The projectiles weren't physical arrows or bullets; they were jagged, glowing red manifestations of bureaucratic hostility, screaming through the air with the unmistakable hum of an impending lawsuit. Vance Harrow didn't have the luxury of dodging. His Heavy Blunt-Force Trauma status made every step look like he was dragging his boots through wet cement. 

[Automated Turret: Cease and Desist Bolt fired.]
[Target Locked: Vance Harrow (Aggro Target).]

Vance stepped into the chokepoint, raising his rusted Rebar in his right hand. The first glowing bolt slammed into the makeshift weapon, scattering into a shower of angry red sparks. 

[Durability Check: Rebar -18%.]
[Warning: Vance Harrow HP is 2/100. Lethal damage imminent.]

"Keep moving!" Vance roared, his voice cracking from the strain. The math was horrifying. Two hit points meant that if a single bolt bypassed the Rebar and clipped his shoulder, his ledger would be permanently closed. 

Rhea Mercer ducked behind his broad back, her lungs burning. The System's Exhaustion (Severe) debuff weighed on her like a physical anchor. With her Stamina sitting at a pathetic 1/150, she couldn't have sprinted if her life depended on it—which it currently did. In her left hand, she gripped the heavy, light-swallowing Null-Value Token, her knuckles white.

"My chassis integrity is currently at thirty-four percent," Unit 734 droned, hovering erratically beside them. Thick plumes of smoke vented from its metallic body, trailing behind them like a grim exhaust pipe. "Critical System Failure Imminent. I strongly advise submitting a formal request for a recess."

"Denied!" Rhea snapped, pushing Vance forward. 

[Damage Mitigated: 100% (Blocked).]
[Durability Check: Rebar -22%.]

Another volley rained down. Vance grunted as the kinetic force of the blocked bolts rattled his blistered hands. The Rebar was vibrating violently, the metal groaning under the sheer weight of the administrative denial. 

"End of the hall!" Vance shouted, lowering his shoulder as they closed the distance. 

The polished stone of the Audit Corridor gave way to a small landing. Before them stood a set of massive, splintered mahogany double doors. The turrets swiveled, their tracking lasers painting Vance's chest, preparing a final, overwhelming barrage. 

There was no time for finesse. Rhea lunged past Vance, planting her boot squarely against the weakened wood. 

Rhea kicks open the inner office doors, stepping through to confront the overseer directly.
